description:
Make, change or remove one listing (a saved view). Listings are how Inistate scopes which entries people see: someone who is not a platform administrator reads an entry, or runs an activity on it, only through a listing they may see. "Own records only" is a listing filtered { "Technician": "me" }, granted to those people, with every wider listing granted to others only.

- Read listings first with get_module_access → listingDefinitions; a listing can be edited from its read-back and sent back. Matched by id, else by name; what you leave out is kept.
- `filters` use the list_entries dialect, "me" included. `access` is this listing's rule, the same as set_module_access's listings.<name>, so a listing can be made and scoped in one call.
- `remove: true` removes the listing with the rules on it.
- Preview with dryRun. A change that lets anyone in who is kept out today — a new listing with no access on a module whose listings are already scoped, a filter change on a granted listing, removing the last listing — returns access_change_requires_confirmation: show the user `changes`, and resend with confirmed: true only after they approve.
- Watch the warnings: unscoped_listing (a listing with no rule shows its entries to everyone), listing_scope_started, creator_outside_scope.

allow.description: Only these get in (everyone else is kept out)

in.description: With profileField: the values that match, e.g. ["Manager", "Director"]

profile.description: A people module: everyone with an entry in it. With profileField: the people module the field is on (needed only when two have it)

profileField.description: The position grant: a people-module field, e.g. Position

deny.description: These are kept out. Alone: everyone except them

others.description: "allowed" with deny + allow: everyone except the denied, and the allowed even if denied

replaceLegacy.description: Required to rewrite an item that still has obsolete listing grants (see the item's legacy in get_module_access)

access.description: This listing's access rule, as in set_module_access

confirmed.description: Set only after the user explicitly approved a change that lets more people in

dryRun.description: Report the changes and warnings without saving

listing.description: The listing: { id?, name, filters?, columns?, icon?, activities? } (ListingDefinition in inistate://schema/configure)

activities.description: Activities to run from this listing too: added to those already bound to specific listings; an unbound activity runs from every listing already

columns.description: Field names to show as columns (state, ID, Created Date … too). Omit to keep them, or on create for the module's first fields

filters.description: Which entries it shows, in the list_entries filter dialect, e.g. { "Technician": "me", "state": "Open" }. Omit to keep the current filter

id.description: The listing's id from listingDefinitions; omit to create (or to match by name)

remove.description: Remove the listing (by id, else name) and the rules on it

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: save_listing
title: Save Listing
